ui.tagline: Know yourself deeply. Be matched on what truly matters.
ui.intro: A patient interviewer builds your social, psychological and intimate portrait, one question at a time, and follows up wherever your answers leave something unsaid. Your portrait stays encrypted on this server and is never sent to any outside service.
ui.name: Display name
ui.consentAdult: I confirm that I am 18 or older.
ui.consentData: I explicitly consent to this service storing and processing my answers about personality, values and sexual preferences in order to build my profile and suggest matches. I can export or erase everything at any time.
ui.reason.contradiction: Two of your answers pulled in different directions here. One more question to see which is closer to the truth.
ui.reason.neutral: You stayed in the middle on this theme. Let me approach it from another side.
ui.reason.depth: This theme weighs heavily in matching, so I'd like to look a little deeper.
ui.done.title: Your portrait is complete
ui.done.text: I have what I need to understand you and to look for people who fit you.

q.lovelang: What makes you feel most loved?
q.open1: I'm drawn to new ideas, art and unfamiliar experiences.
q.open2: I prefer the familiar and proven to the experimental.
q.open3: I often lose myself in imagination or abstract questions.
q.consc1: I plan ahead and follow through on what I commit to.
q.consc2: I tend to leave things to the last minute and improvise.
q.consc3: Order around me matters to my peace of mind.
q.extra1: Being around people gives me energy.
q.extra2: After time in company I need a long stretch alone to recover.
q.extra3: I start conversations with strangers easily.
q.agree1: I naturally put myself in other people's shoes.
q.agree2: I would rather win an argument than keep the peace.
q.agree3: I forgive easily and rarely hold a grudge.
q.stable2: My mood can swing strongly within a single day.
q.stable3: I worry a great deal about things that might go wrong.
q.att_anx1: I worry that a partner may not care for me as much as I care for them.
q.att_anx2: When a partner goes quiet, I quickly fear something is wrong between us.
q.att_anx3: I need frequent reassurance that I am loved.
q.att_avo1: I grow uneasy when someone wants to be very close to me emotionally.
q.att_avo2: I find it easy to lean on a partner and to let them lean on me.
q.att_avo3: When feelings run high, my instinct is to pull back and handle things alone.
q.closeness1: I want to share most of my free time with my partner.
q.closeness2: Inside a relationship I need a lot of space and a life of my own.
q.closeness3: I'd like my partner and me to be each other's first call for almost everything.
q.expressive1: I speak openly about what I feel.
q.expressive2: I usually keep my feelings to myself.
q.expressive3: People can read my emotions on my face.
q.conflict1: When there is a problem, I want to talk it through straight away.
q.conflict2: When there is tension, I'd rather let it cool and avoid the confrontation.
q.conflict3: I can say a hard truth directly, even when it is uncomfortable.
q.tradition1: Traditional roles and customs matter to me in a relationship.
q.tradition2: I question conventions and prefer to write my own rules.
q.tradition3: I'd like my life to look broadly like that of my parents' generation.
q.faith1: Faith or spirituality is central to how I live.
q.faith2: It matters to me that a partner shares my beliefs.
q.faith3: Religion plays no real part in my everyday decisions.
q.ambition1: Career and achievement are among my highest priorities.
q.ambition2: I'd give up a higher income for more free time without hesitation.
q.ambition3: I grow restless unless I'm working towards a big goal.
q.spontaneity1: I love last-minute plans and surprises.
q.spontaneity2: I feel best with a predictable routine.
q.spontaneity3: I'd book a trip leaving tomorrow if the chance came up.
q.social1: My ideal weekend includes going out and meeting people.
q.social2: My ideal evening is a quiet one at home.
q.social3: I like a wide circle of friends and a full calendar.
q.family1: Family is at the centre of my life.
q.family2: I want my partner to be closely involved with my family.
q.family3: I keep my family and my love life largely separate.
q.spender1: I enjoy spending on experiences and pleasures in the moment.
q.spender2: I save carefully and avoid unnecessary spending.
q.spender3: Money is for enjoying now; the future will take care of itself.
q.libido1: I feel sexual desire very often.
q.libido2: A relationship without frequent sex would leave me unfulfilled.
q.libido3: I could go weeks without sex and hardly miss it.
q.sociosex1: I can enjoy sex without emotional attachment.
q.sociosex2: I need deep trust and commitment before I can be intimate.
q.sociosex3: The thought of intimacy with someone new excites me.
q.sexcomm1: I can easily tell a partner exactly what I want in bed.
q.sexcomm2: Talking about sex makes me shy or uncomfortable.
q.sexcomm3: I like to share fantasies and to talk things over afterwards.
q.intensity1: I prefer intimacy that is intense, raw and passionate.
q.intensity2: I prefer intimacy that is slow, tender and gentle.
q.intensity3: A little roughness heightens my desire.
q.experiment1: I'm eager to try new things sexually.
q.experiment2: I'm content with what I know and don't need novelty in bed.
q.experiment3: I have fantasies I would like to live out with the right person.
q.dom1: I enjoy taking control and leading during intimacy.
q.dom2: It arouses me when a partner surrenders to my lead.
q.dom3: I like to decide what happens, when and how.
q.sub1: I enjoy giving up control and being led during intimacy.
q.sub2: It arouses me when a partner takes charge of me.
q.sub3: I like not having to decide — only to follow and feel.
q.kgate: The last part maps specific preferences and kinks, one area at a time, going deeper only where you show interest. It makes intimate matching far more precise. Everything here concerns consenting adults, and you can decline any single question.

dim.open.nlo: You trust what has proven itself. Your depth comes from returning to the same places, people and pleasures, and knowing them better each time.
dim.open.nhi: Your mind reaches towards the unfamiliar. Ideas, art and experiences you have not yet met are nourishment to you, and you wilt a little when life becomes repetition.
dim.consc.nlo: You live by feel rather than by plan. You are at your best when responding to the moment, and structure imposed from outside tends to chafe.
dim.consc.nhi: You keep your word to others and to yourself. Order is not rigidity for you; it is how you make room for what matters.
dim.extra.nlo: Your energy gathers in quiet. You give a great deal to a few people, and you need solitude the way others need company.
dim.extra.nhi: People charge you. You think aloud, open up quickly, and feel most yourself in the warmth of company.
dim.agree.nlo: You would rather be honest than agreeable. You test ideas and people by pushing against them, and you respect those who push back.
dim.agree.nhi: You feel your way into others easily and let go of injuries quickly. Harmony matters to you, sometimes more than being right.
dim.stable.nlo: You feel things at full strength. Worry and joy both arrive vividly, and a partner's calm presence can be a true harbour for you.
dim.stable.nhi: Little shakes you. You carry an inner evenness that others lean on when things turn difficult.
dim.att_anx.nlo: You do not need constant proof of love. Silence from a partner is simply silence to you, and that ease gives the other person room to breathe.
dim.att_anx.nhi: You love attentively and notice the slightest withdrawal. Reassurance is not vanity for you; it is how you settle, and a partner who offers it freely brings out your best.
dim.att_avo.nlo: You let people in. Depending on someone, and being depended on, feels natural to you rather than dangerous.
dim.att_avo.nhi: You protect your inner world. Closeness is something you approach slowly, and when feelings rise you prefer to steady yourself alone before returning.
dim.closeness.nlo: You love from a place of independence. A relationship, for you, is two whole lives that choose to meet, not one life shared.
dim.closeness.nhi: You want a partner woven into your days. Togetherness is not a loss of self for you; it is where you feel most at home.
dim.expressive.nlo: Your feelings run beneath the surface. You show care through presence and action more than through words, and you open up only where you feel safe.
dim.expressive.nhi: What you feel, you say and show. A partner rarely has to guess where they stand with you.
dim.conflict.nlo: In tension you step back and wait for calm. You believe most storms pass by themselves, and you protect the peace of the relationship.
dim.conflict.nhi: You face difficulty directly. An unspoken problem weighs on you more than an uncomfortable conversation ever could.
dim.tradition.nlo: You design your life from first principles. Convention holds no authority over you unless it also makes sense.
dim.tradition.nhi: You find meaning in established roles and customs. They give your relationships a shape you can trust.
dim.faith.nlo: Your compass is worldly. Belief plays little part in your choices, and you do not need a partner to share any creed.
dim.faith.nhi: Faith shapes how you live, and you hope to share that ground with the person beside you.
dim.ambition.nlo: You measure a good life in free hours, not in titles. Work serves your life and not the other way round.
dim.ambition.nhi: You need a summit to climb. Achievement is part of how you know who you are, and you look for a partner who understands the cost.
dim.spontaneity.nlo: Predictability steadies you. You savour things more when you can look forward to them.
dim.spontaneity.nhi: You say yes first and work out the details later. Surprise is one of your pleasures.
dim.social.nlo: Your idea of a good evening has a closed door in it. Home is your centre of gravity.
dim.social.nhi: You like a full calendar and a wide circle. Life, for you, is something that happens among people.
dim.family.nlo: You keep your love life and your family in separate rooms, and you value a couple that stands on its own.
dim.family.nhi: Family is the ground you stand on, and you want a partner who steps into that circle willingly.
dim.spender.nlo: You feel safest with reserves. Money, to you, is security first and pleasure second.
dim.spender.nhi: You spend on living. Experiences are worth more to you than a growing balance.
dim.libido.nlo: Desire visits you rather than lives in you. Intimacy matters, but it is not what holds a relationship together for you.
dim.libido.nhi: Desire is a steady current in your life. Frequent physical intimacy is not a luxury to you; it is part of how you stay connected.
dim.sociosex.nlo: Your body follows your heart. Without trust and commitment, intimacy holds little appeal.
dim.sociosex.nhi: You can enjoy physical connection for its own sake. Novelty attracts you, and sex and attachment are separate questions in your mind.
dim.sexcomm.nlo: Speaking about sex does not come easily. You hope to be understood without having to explain, and you open up with patience.
dim.sexcomm.nhi: You can name what you want. Talking about desire is, for you, part of the pleasure and part of the trust.
dim.intensity.nlo: You are moved by slowness and gentleness. Tenderness is where you open.
dim.intensity.nhi: You want to be swept up. Passion with force and urgency in it is what reaches you.
dim.experiment.nlo: You know what you like and feel no pull to stray from it. Depth, for you, lies in the familiar.
dim.experiment.nhi: You carry fantasies you would like to live, and you treat intimacy as a territory still being discovered.
dim.dom.nlo: Taking control holds little charge for you.
dim.dom.nhi: You come alive when you are leading. A partner's surrender is a gift you take seriously, and directing the encounter is part of your desire.
dim.sub.nlo: Handing over control holds little charge for you.
dim.sub.nhi: You find freedom in letting go. Being led by someone you trust quiets your mind and sharpens what you feel.
